items.subject: english
items.body: Which measure did the library use?

options.text: Late returns per one hundred loans

items.passage_text: A district library tested two ways to remind readers about book returns. At one branch, a notice was placed beside the exit. At another, readers received a printed reminder at checkout. Over four weeks, staff recorded late returns, but the branches served different numbers of readers. The library compared late returns per one hundred loans rather than raw totals. The exit-notice branch moved from 14 to 10 late returns per hundred loans; the checkout-reminder branch moved from 12 to 9. The staff report described a decline at both sites and noted that readers were not randomly assigned to branches.

items.subject: english
items.body: Which result is supported?

items.subject: english
items.body: What remained on while the speaker was silent?
items.passage_text: When the school radio stopped working, Kavya carried it to the repair room. She noted that the indicator light remained on while the speaker was silent. The technician asked her to test one connection at a time: first the power lead, then the volume control, and finally the speaker wire. The loose speaker wire was the cause. Kavya tightened it and tested the radio again. She added the sequence to the room’s repair notebook so the next student could repeat the checks. The radio worked, but the notebook became the part she was most pleased to leave behind.

items.subject: english
items.body: Where was the chair first placed?
items.passage_text: At dusk, the courtyard filled with the sound of chairs being moved. The caretaker placed one beneath the neem tree, then carried it inside when the wind lifted the first dry leaves. A child asked why the gathering had to end. He pointed to the open windows: the voices had not vanished; they had travelled indoors. From the corridor came the same song, softer now, threaded with the clink of cups. The child folded the paper invitation in her pocket and followed the sound. Outside, the tree kept its quiet place in the dark.

items.subject: english
items.body: Which label passed most checks?
items.passage_text: A student group compared three labels for its seed collection. One showed only the plant name, another showed only the sowing date, and a third recorded both. During the next month, members checked whether each label helped identify the correct tray without opening the seed log. The combined label succeeded in 18 of 20 checks, the date-only label in 11, and the name-only label in 15. The group cautioned that the small trial covered only its own collection and one month. It chose the combined label for the next planting cycle.
